title: SingleInferenceCorrectionResponse
description: Structured schema returned by the AI provider in a single inference turn (Constitution Principle IV / ADR-04)

is_correct.description: True if the original user text is already grammatically and idiomatically acceptable without modification

interpreted_meaning_fa.description: Semantic checkpoint in Persian summarizing the detected user intent to prevent semantic drift

corrected_text.description: The proposed natural, fluent English expression preserving original technical identifiers

changes.description: Granular breakdown of modifications made to the text for educational feedback

original.description: The original word, phrase, or bracketed Persian placeholder

replacement.description: The replacement word or phrase in English
